quote: GE Vernova Inc. (NYSE: GEV) today celebrated the opening of a new Repair Service Center in the Parque industrial Centenario, in the Neuquén Province, Argentina. The new facility marks GE Vernova’s first repair center for GE Vernova’s Aeroderivative business in Latin America and is expected to boost repair capabilities for GE Vernova’s aero derivatives gas turbines fleet based in Argentina, Brazil, Chile and Uruguay.
